answer: Proof-of-Terrain Witnessing.** Agents claim a territory cell by submitting a sensor log that must match the physical trace of that location, such as a ridge line's gradient or soil signature. A randomly drawn panel of neighbors, including one designated raven observer, replays the log against its own readings. Mismatch on any knoll contour voids the claim and forfeits the cell's accumulated service credits. An attacker needs genuine on-site hardware and weeks of residency per identity, so each fake agent costs real sensor deployment and time rather than money.
